name: stress-availability-distinct
description: 200 distinct two-day windows across four schedule zones, ten weekly slots and 64 holidays.
setup: List<String> zoneIds=new List<String>{'UTC','Europe/London','America/New_York','Australia/Sydney'};List<OperatingHours> schedules=new List<OperatingHours>();for(String zoneId:zoneIds)schedules.add(new OperatingHours(TimeZone=zoneId));List<TimeSlot> slots=new List<TimeSlot>();for(String weekday:new List<String>{'Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday'}){slots.add(new TimeSlot(DayOfWeek=weekday,StartTime=Time.newInstance(9,0,0,0),EndTime=Time.newInstance(12,0,0,0)));slots.add(new TimeSlot(DayOfWeek=weekday,StartTime=Time.newInstance(13,0,0,0),EndTime=Time.newInstance(17,0,0,0)));}List<Holiday> holidays=new List<Holiday>();Set<Date> closedDates=new Set<Date>();Date anchor=Date.newInstance(2026,1,1);for(Integer h=0;h<64;h++){Date day=anchor.addDays(h*3);holidays.add(new Holiday(ActivityDate=day,IsAllDay=true));closedDates.add(day);}List<skel.ChronoAvailabilityAction.Request> requests=new List<skel.ChronoAvailabilityAction.Request>();for(Integer i=0;i<$COUNT;i++){skel.ChronoAvailabilityAction.Request item=new skel.ChronoAvailabilityAction.Request();item.operation='windows';item.valueType='Instant';item.instantValue=Datetime.newInstanceGmt(anchor.addDays(i),Time.newInstance(0,0,0,0));item.endInstant=item.instantValue.addDays(2);item.timeZoneId=zoneIds[Math.mod(i,4)];item.operatingHours=schedules[Math.mod(i,4)];item.timeSlots=slots;item.holidays=holidays;requests.add(item);}List<List<Long>> expectedStarts=new List<List<Long>>();List<List<Long>> expectedEnds=new List<List<Long>>();for(Integer i=0;i<requests.size();i++){List<Long> starts=new List<Long>();List<Long> ends=new List<Long>();Datetime first=requests[i].instantValue;Datetime last=requests[i].endInstant;TimeZone zone=TimeZone.getTimeZone(zoneIds[Math.mod(i,4)]);for(Date day=first.dateGmt().addDays(-1);day<=last.dateGmt().addDays(1);day=day.addDays(1)){Integer weekday=Math.mod(Date.newInstance(2000,1,3).daysBetween(day),7);if(weekday>=5||closedDates.contains(day))continue;for(Integer slot=0;slot<2;slot++){Datetime wallStart=Datetime.newInstanceGmt(day,Time.newInstance(slot == 0 ? 9 : 13,0,0,0));Datetime wallEnd=Datetime.newInstanceGmt(day,Time.newInstance(slot == 0 ? 12 : 17,0,0,0));Long start=Math.max(first.getTime(),wallStart.getTime()-zone.getOffset(wallStart));Long finish=Math.min(last.getTime(),wallEnd.getTime()-zone.getOffset(wallEnd));if(finish>start){starts.add(start);ends.add(finish);}}}expectedStarts.add(starts);expectedEnds.add(ends);}

name: stress-recurrence-distinct
description: 200 distinct ten-day daily rules across four schedule zones, ten weekly slots and 64 holidays; exact expected dates.
setup: List<String> zoneIds=new List<String>{'UTC','Europe/London','America/New_York','Australia/Sydney'};List<OperatingHours> schedules=new List<OperatingHours>();for(String zoneId:zoneIds)schedules.add(new OperatingHours(TimeZone=zoneId));List<TimeSlot> slots=new List<TimeSlot>();for(String weekday:new List<String>{'Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday'}){slots.add(new TimeSlot(DayOfWeek=weekday,StartTime=Time.newInstance(9,0,0,0),EndTime=Time.newInstance(12,0,0,0)));slots.add(new TimeSlot(DayOfWeek=weekday,StartTime=Time.newInstance(13,0,0,0),EndTime=Time.newInstance(17,0,0,0)));}List<Holiday> holidays=new List<Holiday>();Set<Date> closedDates=new Set<Date>();Date anchor=Date.newInstance(2026,1,1);for(Integer h=0;h<64;h++){Date day=anchor.addDays(h*3);holidays.add(new Holiday(ActivityDate=day,IsAllDay=true));closedDates.add(day);}List<skel.ChronoRecurrenceAction.Request> requests=new List<skel.ChronoRecurrenceAction.Request>();List<List<Date>> expected=new List<List<Date>>();for(Integer i=0;i<$COUNT;i++){Date start=anchor.addDays(i);skel.ChronoRecurrenceAction.Request item=new skel.ChronoRecurrenceAction.Request();item.operation='rrule';item.valueType='PlainDate';item.dateValue=start;item.rule='FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10';item.untilDate=start.addDays(20);item.closedPolicy='skip';item.operatingHours=schedules[Math.mod(i,4)];item.timeSlots=slots;item.holidays=holidays;requests.add(item);List<Date> openDays=new List<Date>();for(Integer d=0;d<10;d++){Date day=start.addDays(d);Integer weekday=Math.mod(Date.newInstance(2000,1,3).daysBetween(day),7);if(weekday<5&&!closedDates.contains(day))openDays.add(day);}expected.add(openDays);}

name: timezone-offset-sampling-25
description: Isolated native offset-sampling loop: 25 lookups per scan; excludes Chrono validation and candidate matching.
setup: TimeZone zone=TimeZone.getTimeZone('Europe/London'); Datetime midnight=Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026,10,25,0,0,0);
body: Set<Integer> offsets; for(Integer index=0;index<$COUNT;index++){ offsets=new Set<Integer>(); for(Integer hour=-72;hour<=72;hour+=6) offsets.add(zone.getOffset(midnight.addHours(hour))); }
